Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan said the country must gradually take full responsibility for guarding its national borders, replacing Russian border guards. Asked whether Yerevan had a clear plan identifying which sections of the border would see Russian personnel replaced by Armenian guards, Pashinyan said: “We are grateful to the Russian border guards for having stood at our borders all these years. But I believe that in the coming years, we must fully assume responsibility for guarding our state borders.”
